description: Come join Matt and other volunteers to door knock! This is a great way to spread our campaign’s message about “building bridges and getting results” to voters in Blaine and Lexington. Don’t have any door knocking experience? Don’t worry—no experience is required! We’ll provide you with everything

title: July 22 Door Knocking with Matt — Matt Norris for MN House
